notes.title: v0.44.01 update, 4 new games! Now with a total of 44 games!
notes.content: [p]Hey there![/p][p]A new version awaits! This time, we've got 4 new games to a total of 44 in shuffler mode. No changes to the arcades as now I actually want to finish all 52 games in shuffler mode first, then focus on converting them to full arcades. 8 more games to go before we reach 52 games![/p][p][/p][p]So here are the new games:[/p][p][b]Water Racing[/b] - Well, okay, not really a racing game. More of a shooter game with racing elements that takes the racing game spot in the shuffler mode. In this game, you need to selectively attack the various objects to maximize your points. Some obstacles take more hits than others but give you a bigger score. Just don't collide into them![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45395729/1b9899e771fefcbfe5f82dab1cc6fefe7f0ad817.png"][/img][/p][p][b]A Mine Sweeper Clone (with a twist)[/b]- Here's a mine sweeper clone, and it plays almost like the original except for a couple of changes to make it work better with a one button time limited shuffler style gameplay. Firstly, you don't lose the entire game if you hit a mine, just two seconds of your time before you can continue. So if you think you're stuck and your next move will take more than 2 seconds, go ahead and take that risk! Second, it auto-reveals mines around the obvious numbers. This means that if a square has the number 2 and there are only 2 remaining blocks to reveal around it, those are auto revealed as mines.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45395729/d303a3706dde433586f6e7dc7e938db12f35397c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Robot Attack[/b] - It's like a hybrid of Contra and Missle Command. Shoot at robots and missiles that come at you from various angles. Watch out as certain enemies can seek you out so you need to destroy them otherwise you're toast![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45395729/c883ef821f01974d50e9186981236d6bdda2e88b.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Mousey Lifts[/b] - Am I the only one here with a nostalgic soft spot for Gyromite? For some reason, I loved being able to lift/drop down pipes to solve platformer puzzles. So here's a game inspired by Gyromite where you lift or drop pipes to either bring your mousey to new places or to smash those rolling enemies,[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45395729/6764880ee76e9c008737bb1c8d16aafdd51391eb.png"][/img][/p][p]And some of fixes/features:[/p][list][*][p]A new reset button in the disable room to quickly clear the star and all disables[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where the new game unlocked sometimes won't show up if you're using the star icon.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced level up goals across the board in Shuffler mode. Now you can unlock new games faster![/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Enjoy!![/p]

notes.title: Epic Update! Lots of new features, 5 new games, & a debut of full arcade games!
notes.content:
So I've got a treat for all of you who have been waiting for this update. Lots of great new features in this build.

[b]To summarize: [/b] Multiple save slots, 5 new games including a metroidvania style game, an epic boss battle, new special events system with 4 new special events, new stage variation engine applied to multiple early games, a new full arcade system applied to 4 arcades, a new star item that lets you pick whatever game you always want included, a new speed run mode, and a new insane mode,

[h2]Firstly, let me introduce to you the new save slot system:[/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/U9ZEgjN.png[/img]

Now you can pick and play using up to 3 different save slots and delete any that you don't want. As a bonus, I've made sure that the score submitted to Steam achievements is based on the total score of all 3 save slots. Feel free to start a new game if you're chasing that last score achievement.

[h1]5 New games including one with a Metroidvania style engine![/h1]

Firstly, a game inspired by the original Snake, but with its own twist. You don't lose the game when you touch your tail. Your tail just gets cut off and you keep going. However, the longer your tail, the bigger the score. You also move from room to room, eating enough food for the door to open.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/JnDKN37.png[/img]

Next, a racing game. This time, it's a skateboarding dog! Woof! Jump, speed up, or slow down to avoid all those pesky obstacles.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ap63lAd.png[/img]

Now play a game inspired by Frogger. Except you're a kangaroo stuck in the future! The twist here is that the kangaroo can punch things. Its punch can easily destroy cars, robots, and laser shooting machines. Power Kangaroo!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Yo9t29H.png[/img]

Next is an undersea game. Play as a sea turtle swimming away from a shark. Mash the button to make the turtle swim faster, avoid all those dangerous sea creature and out swim the shark!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/45cSTdQ.png[/img]

And lastly, the Metroidvania style game. Navigate your way through interconnected horizontal and vertical pathways. But in this game, you cannot jump. Instead, you boost and double boost in any direction you want. As you boost, you also destroy enemies and travel with speed.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/SyRgwvG.png[/img]

[h1]A new epic boss battle![/h1]

The fourth boss battle! If you've been playing lately, you'll notice M.O.M. has been acting up. You'll need to play this boss battle to see what is up with that!

[h1]New special events![/h1]

New special events that modifies how the game is played. A new type of special event unlocks after each boss you beat and appears every once in a while after playing a few games. Here are some of them!

[b]Gem Rain Event[/b] - Tons of gems rain down all across the screen. You can collect them as you play all the games. However, don't get too distracted!
[b]Speed Up Event[/b] - The game runs at 2x the speed and you also get 2x the points!
[b]Obstruction Event [/b]- A giant spider flies across the screen and blocks your view as you play the games. Get 2x the points here as well! Occasionally a red gem appears!

Plus if you don't like the event, you can easily back out when they appear and everything returns back to normal.

[h1]Challenges section re-work![/h1]

I've removed some of the old fixed challenges with a new Speed Run challenge and an Insane challenge mode. The daily challenge is still there. The daily challenge leaderboard has now been set to read and write to a single leaderboard.

The new speed run challenge picks several games and keeps playing them non-stop until you reach a specific score. In the end, you're judged by how fast you reach that score. This mode unlocks at level 15.

The insane mode is pretty insane. Let's say that in a single playthrough, you're likely to play through almost every single game in the collection. This mode unlocks at level 30.

[h1]New stage variation engine[/h1]

There's a new stage variation engine, making it easier to create different stages for each game in shuffle mode. Here are the list of games with new multiple stages:

[b]Car racing[/b] - 3 stages: Summer, Fall, and Winter!
[b]Platformer [/b]- 3 stages: Play in the field, on building tops, or in the underground.
[b]Shooter [/b]- 3 stages: The normal stage, a rock stage, and a grid stage where the background can destroy you.
[b]Puzzle [/b]- 2 stages: Play the normal stage, and a new stage with a special star that eliminates anything that you swap it with.
[b]Truck Maze[/b] - 3 stages with different powerups in each stage.
[b]Dungeon [/b]- 2 stages with different level room layouts.

[h1]Full arcade games![/h1]

Four games in the arcade have been made as full arcade games! As the system is now in place to implement these, expect more and more arcades to be implemented. I've implemented them with a rock hard challenge in mind, so I hope you'll find them to be quite challenging. Also, no save states here! Just that good old classic console challenge with no continues. Here are the current games that have been converted to full arcade games:

[b]Platformer (Jump Boy!)[/b] - 6 stages are currently implemented with various themes, getting harder and harder as you progress.
[b]Shooter (Aquarius)[/b] - 3 stages with a boss battle at the end of each stage. Each stage presents different themes, enemies, and obstacles.
[b]Digger (Dig Dig Dig) [/b]- 8 stages with an ever increasing difficulty progression, with each new stage getting longer with different enemy variations.
[b]Truck Maze (Garbage Truck Hero)[/b]- Play through 9 different stages, with each stage presenting a different challenge with varying level sizes and gameplay. Reach your daily garbage collection quota!

The full arcade games will have a star above them, so you'll know which ones to play.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/unsek4B.png[/img]

They also have those fun custom music jingles for each game before, between each level, and during game over, so give them a go!

[h1]And more![/h1]

There's a new star item that lets you pick a game to always be included in the game randomizer list. You'll get this after the new 4th boss fight.

And other changes:
- Added double and triple shot to Monster Attack to make it more engaging 
- Added an indicator to tell you if you have a game disabled on the play pipe
- Added acceleration to character in the main menu scene to make it faster to go through the longer list of games
Dungeon Updates:
  - Added closed doors. When this happens, you must beat all enemies in the room.
  - Increased player projectile speed
  - Player projectiles now go through blocks and enemy projectiles
  - Those annoying shooting enemies can now be destroyed. Hooray!
- Other misc fixes & visual improvements

Phew! That's a lot of stuff to share!

Feel free to join us at the Discord server and help develop the game! I'll be setting up polls and gathering feedback there!

https://discord.gg/MZxSC7Kt

Cheers!

notes.content:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/wW1Dz8M.png[/img]

[b]Doors & Elevators[/b] - For this game, my oldest son really wanted to help build a game, so I let him give some design inputs and helped compose the music. Inspired by Elevator Action, use elevators and doors to strategize climbing the multi floor building and destroy the aliens!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/nDUfBxK.png[/img]

Boom! - Play the bomb throwing game and see how far you can get!
Wall Wrecker - Play the match 3 + platformer game inspired by Wrecking Crew, now in arcade mode.
Space Alert - The Asteroids clone. Destroy as many asteroids and space ships within the time limit!

[list]
[*] Improved maze generation routines
[*] Reduced enemy bombers chasing distance

[list]
[*] Reduction of score to level up values across the board
[*] Also, I think something is starting to go wrong with M.O.M. I hope she is okay.
[/list]

notes.title: Update v0.27.01 - 3 New Games, New Boss Battle, 5 New Arcades, and more!
notes.content:
[h1]3 New Games![/h1]

A classic game featuring a girl with a hammer, inspired by Mr.Do's Castle and classic Mario Bros.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/EyutEDd.png[/img]

A racing game inspired by top-down games like RC Pro-am and Micro Machines.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/iBKSLE3.png[/img]

A bit like Tetris, but it's a platformer. You can speed up or slow down the blocks by pressing down or up.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/HzIPuWQ.png[/img]

[h3]5 New Arcades, complete with knock-off sounding names:[/h3]
[b]The Dungeon[/b] - Seek out the boss and beat it within the time limit!
[b]Dig Dig Dig[/b] - Play the digging game at a longer time and gets harder as you go deeper!
[b]Final Punch[/b] - Play the brawler game. It gets harder as time goes by.
[b]To The Sky[/b] - That jumping game where you try to jump higher and higher.
[b]Wild Journey[/b] - It's the RPG game, but now you can play it for longer!

[h3]Updates to Previous Arcades:[/h3]
[b]Shooter[/b] - You can now complete the arcade by facing and beating the boss!
[b]Pipe Land [/b]- Added trash cans so that you can throw away all the pieces that you hate. And sorry, but I don't think recycling bins were that popular yet in the 80's, so trash cans it is! Also reduced the amount of blocking blocks to make it easier.

[h3]Other Features:[/h3]
- 5 New achievements!
- Added a new invincible star item for Penguin Treasure Hunt. Now you can destroy those pesky spiky balls!
- New audio jingle for the red gem
- Reduced missile hit box in truck maze

[h3]And fixes:[/h3]
[b]RPG [/b]- Fix for spawning in a small island fix, for sure this time!
[b]Platformer [/b]- You can now duck by pressing down
[b]Boss Battles[/b] - Fixed same game occasionally appearing twice in succession issue
+ Various stability fixes

notes.title: Update v0.24.01 - New Arcade Mode, New Game, and More!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/oLqM44j.png[/img]

[h2][b]New arcade mode![/b][/h2]
  - Play each game on their own in the arcade! Arcade mode unlocks at level 5.
  - Currently contains 6 arcades, each with their own custom pixelated cabinet design, title screens, progression, and leaderboards! I will keep adding more arcades with each main update.
  - You can now collect coins from the endurance games! Use them to purchase arcade machines from M.O.M.
  - For existing players, you get free extra coins, 5 for each level you've reached beyond level 1
  - M.O.M. only sells 3 arcades at a time. The arcades will either refresh after some time (currently 30 minutes) or if you buy all the arcades and leave then come back

[h2][b]New game![/b][/h2]
[b]Pipe Land[/b] - Arcade only game! This one is a challenging one that just doesn't work well in endurance mode. It's inspired by pipe dream, except that you can use the water to help destroy blocks to help reach new areas. Unlocks at the arcade shop at level 15.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/vpkOJAh.png[/img]

[h2][b]Game updates![/b][/h2]
[b]Brawler:[/b] Updated visuals and added varying speeds for enemies. A new common fighter is added that moves faster. The big guy now fights closer to you and doesn't back off as much. Adjusted enemy speeds, strength, and points.
[b]Horizontal Shooter:[/b] Sped up single bullet rate so that it doesn't feel as useless without the upgrades
[b]RPG:[/b] Improved map size detection to reduce stuck on small island probability
[b]Jumper:[/b] Improved visuals, better level layout for improved flow
[b]Slime Fall:[/b] Some fixes to level layout
[b]Truck Maze (Garbage Truck Hero):[/b] Some improvements to the controls, fixing some invincibility damage bugs
[b]Dungeon:[/b] Mousey now goes twice as fast if it sees you in front!
  [b]New enemy![/b] Meet mud man, always slowly on the move and takes a few hits. Hit it directly at close range for faster kills! Unlocks at level 10.
 [b] New enemy![/b] Meet bat. Flies around aimlessly. When it senses the player nearby, expect a chase! Unlocks at level 15.

[h2][b]Other fixes:[/b][/h2]
- Removed the bonus points and replaced them with coins. As a result, level up requirements has been reduced across the board.
- Support for windowed mode with different aspect ratios (press alt+enter to enter windowed mode)
- Player now celebrates during level up because you are worth it!
- Plus all sorts of misc bug fixes and stability improvements

Enjoy!

notes.title: Update v0.23.02, Feb 1, 2025 - A tuning pass patch
notes.content:
Hello!

I've updated the game once again. This time, it's a quick tuning patch based on player feedback from focus testing to make sure the game is as fun as possible! Here are the changes:

[b]Paddle Game [/b]- Ball regeneration time reduced from 3 to 2 seconds. Less time = more balls on screen!
[b]Digger [/b]- Reduced time it takes to dig so the game now plays faster and more fun
[b]Jumper[/b] - Reduced player speed a bit in 2x mode as it was feeling a bit too crazy
[b]Truck Maze[/b] - Reduced player speed a bit in 2x mode, but made up for it by giving an extra speed boost while holding the button for those who know that holding diagonal lets you take the next corner (shhh... it's a secret between us!)

Have fun!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/aR14dUC.png[/img]

A new game approaches! Game #23! It's like Punch-Out! But you're boxing a robot. Hey! No fair! He also bends the rules and sometimes throws bombs at you! Yikes! But you're strong, right? Right????

[img]https://i.imgur.com/DcmBs21.png[/img]

[b]New features![/b]
Two new challenges awaits in the challenge room with leaderboards! Can you beat my score?
Daily leaderboards now lets you travel back in time and see your leaderboards from the past.
You can now view your friends leaderboard [Player requested feature!] 

[b]And some game improvements:[/b]
